source.name: USDA MyPlate Kitchen
source.credit: Wellness Ways Resource Book: Taste of the World, University of Illinois Extension Service

ingredients.name: unsalted butter, 1 full stick plus 2 tablespoons

steps.instruction: Preheat the oven to 350 °F.
Beat 10 tablespoons of unsalted butter with 3/4 cup of sugar until creamy.
Add 3 large eggs one at a time, beating until well blended.
Add 1 3/4 cups flour, 2 teaspoons baking powder and 1 tablespoon lemon rind.
Beat the batter for 4 minutes.
Pour the batter into a greased 9-inch springform pan.
Arrange 2 sliced medium apples on the batter.
Sprinkle the apples with 2 teaspoons of sugar.
Bake for 1 hour at 350 °F in the preheated oven.
Remove the cake from the pan.
Brush the apples with 8 tablespoons of apricot jam.
Let the cake cool before serving.

source.name: USDA MyPlate Kitchen
source.credit: Meeting Your MyPlate Goals on a Budget, MyPlate National Strategic Partners Toolkit

ingredients.name: red apple, halved, cored and diced
jalapeno pepper, seeded and finely chopped (or 1/4 teaspoon dried pepper flakes)
fresh sage, chopped (or 1 1/2 teaspoons dried rubbed sage)

steps.instruction: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add 4 ounces of chopped pecans and stir often.
steps.spoken: Add 4 ounces of chopped pecans and stir often. Cook the pecans for 2 to 3 minutes, stirring often, until they begin to brown.

steps.instruction: Set the pecans aside on a separate plate.
Heat 1 teaspoon of the oil in the skillet over medium heat.
Add 1 1/2 cups of diced celery and 1 1/2 cups of diced onions.
steps.spoken: Add 1 1/2 cups of diced celery and 1 1/2 cups of diced onions. Cook for 8 minutes, stirring now and then, until the celery and onions begin to brown lightly at the edges.

steps.instruction: Add 1 diced red apple and cook for 4 minutes.
steps.spoken: Add 1 diced red apple and cook for 4 minutes. Add the diced apple and cook for 4 minutes, until it is tender but still crisp.

steps.instruction: Stir in the pecans, 2 cups of hot cooked brown rice and 1 cup of wild rice.
Stir in 1/2 cup of dried cranberries and the finely chopped jalapeno pepper.
steps.spoken: Stir in 1/2 cup of dried cranberries and the finely chopped jalapeno pepper. You can use 1/4 teaspoon of dried pepper flakes instead.

steps.instruction: Stir in 1 1/2 tablespoons of chopped sage and 3/4 teaspoon of salt.
steps.spoken: Stir in 1 1/2 tablespoons of chopped sage and 3/4 teaspoon of salt. Stir in the chopped fresh sage, or use 1 1/2 teaspoons of dried rubbed sage, and the salt.

steps.instruction: Cook 3 minutes, stirring now and then, until the rice mixture is hot.
steps.spoken: Cook for 3 to 4 minutes, stirring now and then, until the rice mixture is heated through.

source.name: USDA MyPlate Kitchen
source.credit: Created by Fresh Avocados Love One Today, a member of the MyPlate National Strategic Partnership Program

ingredients.name: cauliflower, cut into 1/2-inch thick slices, then into 2-inch pieces, 8 ounces total
reduced fat shredded Mexican or taco seasoned cheese
black beans, drained and rinsed, about 15 ounces
ripe avocado, halved, pitted, peeled and diced
scallions, sliced on the diagonal, about 1/2 cup

steps.instruction: Preheat the oven to 425 °F.
Mix 2 tablespoons of olive oil and 1 tablespoon of chili powder in a bowl.
Mix in 1 teaspoon of cumin, 1/2 teaspoon of garlic powder and 1/4 teaspoon of salt.
Brush half of the oil mixture on the bottom of a 15x10 inch baking sheet.
Arrange 1/2 head of cauliflower pieces and 1 sliced zucchini in one layer on the sheet.
Brush the remaining oil mixture over the vegetables.
Roast for 20 minutes, until the vegetables are fork tender.
Top with 1 can of black beans, 1 cup of corn kernels and 1 cup of shredded cheese.
Roast for 5 more minutes, until heated through and the cheese is melted.
Top with 1 cup of cherry tomatoes, 1 diced avocado and 2 sliced scallions.
Top with 1 sliced jalapeño and 2 tablespoons of cilantro.

source.name: USDA MyPlate Kitchen
source.credit: Simple Healthy Recipes, Oklahoma Nutrition Information and Education, ONIE Project

steps.instruction: Preheat the oven to 425 °F.
Mix 1 pound of ground beef, 1 egg and 1/2 teaspoon of dried parsley in a bowl.
steps.spoken: Mix 1 pound of ground beef, 1 egg and 1/2 teaspoon of dried parsley in a bowl. You can use ground turkey instead of beef.

steps.instruction: Mix in 1/2 cup of bread crumbs and 1/2 cup of milk.
Mix in 1/4 teaspoon of black pepper and 1 teaspoon of onion powder.
Shape the mixture into about 24 meatballs.
Spray the baking sheets with cooking spray.
Arrange the meatballs on the baking sheets.
Bake for 12 minutes.
steps.spoken: Bake for 12 to fifteen minutes. Check with a food thermometer. It should read 160 °F for ground beef and 165 °F for ground turkey.

steps.instruction: Chill any meatballs you are saving right away.
Package the saved meatballs in meal-sized amounts and freeze them right away.

source.name: USDA MyPlate Kitchen
source.credit: USDA’S Collection of Nonfat Dry Milk (NDM) Recipes, USDA Food and Nutrition Service, Food Distribution Service

ingredients.name: water, to mix with the dry milk

steps.instruction: Mix 2/3 cup of non-fat dry milk with 2 cups of water.
Add the milk, 1/8 teaspoon of salt and 2 3/4 cups of water to a small saucepan.
Heat over medium heat until steaming hot, but not boiling.
Add 2 cups of quick cooking oats, stirring until creamy.
steps.spoken: Add the oats and cook, stirring, for 1 to two minutes, until creamy.

steps.instruction: Take the pan off the heat.
Stir in 2 mashed ripe bananas and 2 tablespoons of maple syrup.
Divide the oatmeal between 4 bowls.
Top with 2 tablespoons of chopped walnuts.
Crush 9 ounces of gingernut biscuits into crumbs with a rolling pin.
steps.spoken: Crush 9 ounces of gingernut biscuits into crumbs with the end of a rolling pin. It is easiest inside a freezer bag, so crumbs don't spill.

steps.instruction: Melt 4 ounces of the butter in a large pan.
Take the pan off the heat and mix in the biscuit crumbs.
Press the crumbs into the bottom of an 8 inch loose-bottomed pie tin.
Put the pie tin in the fridge to chill.
Put the other 6 ounces of butter and 3/4 cup of sugar in a medium pan.
Melt over medium heat, stirring, until the sugar just starts to melt.
Add 1 can of sweetened condensed milk and bring to a boil.
Stir all the time for 5 minutes to make the caramel.
Slice 2 bananas and arrange them over the crumb base.
Pour the caramel over the top.
Chill for at least 1 hour so the caramel firms up.
Before serving, whip 2/3 cup of double cream.
Spoon the whipped cream over the top.

source.name: USDA MyPlate Kitchen
source.credit: In the Kitchen with Chef Stephanie Green, Arizona Nutrition Network

steps.instruction: Preheat the oven to 350 °F.
Mash 4 cups of pinto beans coarsely in a large bowl with a fork or potato masher.
Stir 1 tablespoon of chili powder into the beans.
Wrap 8 flour tortillas in a damp paper towel.
Microwave the tortillas on high for 45 seconds, until soft and warm.
Divide the bean mixture among the tortillas, spreading it down the center.
Sprinkle 1/2 cup of cheese over the bean mixture.
Roll up each tortilla to enclose the filling.
Spray a 9 by 13 inch baking dish with nonstick cooking spray.
Place the enchiladas, seam side down, in the baking dish.
Cover with foil and bake for 20 minutes, until heated through.
Serve the enchiladas warm, with salsa if you like.

ingredients.name: beef, lamb or mutton, cut into small pieces

steps.instruction: Heat a small pan over medium heat.
Add 1 teaspoon each of cumin, coriander, fennel and mustard seeds.
Dry roast the seeds until they smell fragrant.
Grind the roasted spices to a powder.
steps.spoken: Grind the roasted spices in a spice grinder, or with a mortar and pestle.

steps.instruction: In a small bowl, add 1 tablespoon each of ginger paste and garlic paste.
Add 1 teaspoon each of garam masala, paprika, chile flakes and turmeric.
Add 1 teaspoon of salt and 2 tablespoons of yogurt.
Add 2 tablespoons each of lemon juice and oil, and mix well.
steps.spoken: Add the ground spices, 2 tablespoons of lemon juice and 2 tablespoons of oil, and mix well to make the marinade.

steps.instruction: Put 1 pound of beef, lamb or mutton in a large bowl.
Pour the marinade over the meat and mix well to coat it.
Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 4 hours.
steps.spoken: Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 4 hours, or overnight.

steps.instruction: Heat a grill to medium-high.
Thread the marinated meat onto skewers.
Grill for 8 minutes, turning occasionally.
steps.spoken: Grill for 8 to 10 minutes, turning occasionally, until the meat is browned all over and no longer pink in the middle.

source.name: USDA MyPlate Kitchen
source.credit: USDA Center for Nutrition Policy and Promotion

ingredients.name: low-sodium black beans, drained and rinsed (15.5 ounces)

steps.instruction: Mash 1 can of drained, rinsed black beans in a bowl with a fork until chunky.
Add 1 egg and mix well.
Add 1/2 cup of cooked brown rice, 2 minced scallions and 1 minced garlic clove.
Add 2 tablespoons of cilantro and 1/4 teaspoon of oregano.
Add 1/2 teaspoon each of salt and black pepper, and mix until well combined.
Divide the mixture into 4 portions.
Shape each portion into a patty 3/4 to 1 inch thick.
Heat a large skillet on high heat.
Add 1 teaspoon of vegetable oil to the hot skillet.
Add the burgers to the skillet.
steps.spoken: Cook the burgers 4 to five minutes on this side.

steps.instruction: Flip and cook 4 more minutes, until browned on both sides.
steps.spoken: Flip the burgers and cook 4 to five more minutes, until browned on both sides and hot all the way through.

steps.instruction: Place each burger on a whole-wheat bun.

source.name: based.cooking
source.credit: based.cooking contributor riley-ross

steps.instruction: Put 1 cup of blueberries in a blender.
Add 1 cup of whole milk and 1/2 cup of whole Greek yogurt.
Add a dab of honey, a drop or two of vanilla and some oats or granola if you like.
Blend for about 10 seconds.
steps.spoken: Blend for about 10 seconds. This makes 1 to 2 servings.

ingredients.name: sausage links, cooked and finely chopped

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 375 °F.
Combine 5 chopped cooked sausage links and 8 slices of crumbled bacon in a bowl.
In another bowl, mix 1 cup of ricotta cheese and 4 beaten eggs.
Add 1/4 cup of unsalted butter, 1/2 teaspoon of salt and 1/2 teaspoon of pepper.
Mix in 2 cups of finely crumbled cornbread.
Spread just enough cornbread mixture to cover the bottom of a greased large pan.
Add just enough of the meat mixture to cover that layer.
Repeat the layers until all the mixtures are used.
Combine 1 cup of shredded Monterey Jack cheese and 1/2 cup of dry breadcrumbs.
Sprinkle the cheese mixture evenly over the layers.
Bake for 30 minutes, until browned and bubbly on top.
steps.spoken: Bake for 30 to 35 minutes, or until the top is browned and bubbly.

source.name: USDA MyPlate Kitchen
source.credit: Don’t Play With Your Food: Fall and Winter Cookbook, Arizona Nutrition Network

steps.instruction: Put 4 cups of broccoli, 1 small onion and 4 cups of broth in a large saucepan.
Bring the soup to a boil.
Reduce the heat, cover and simmer for 10 minutes, until the vegetables are tender.
steps.spoken: Reduce the heat, cover and simmer for about 10 minutes, until the vegetables are tender.

steps.instruction: Prepare 1/2 cup of instant mashed potatoes with water to make 1 cup.
Add 1 cup of evaporated milk to the soup.
Slowly stir in the mashed potatoes.
Cook, stirring constantly, until bubbly and thickened.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
steps.spoken: Season with salt and pepper to taste. If the soup starts to get too thick, stir in a little more milk or water.

steps.instruction: Ladle the soup into serving bowls.
Sprinkle about 1 tablespoon of cheese over each serving.

source.name: USDA MyPlate Kitchen
source.credit: In the Kitchen with Chef Stephanie Green, Arizona Nutrition Network

steps.instruction: Put 6 cups of broccoli, 1 cup of raisins and 1 diced red onion in a medium bowl.
Add 2 tablespoons of sugar, 2 tablespoons of lemon juice and 3/4 cup of mayonnaise.
Add 8 slices of cooked, crumbled bacon, if you like.
Mix everything well.
Chill the salad for 1 hour.
steps.spoken: Chill the salad for 1 to two hours.

source.name: USDA MyPlate Kitchen
source.credit: Food Hero, Oregon State University Cooperative Extension Service

steps.instruction: Cover 1/3 cup of dried bulgur with 1 cup of boiling water.
steps.spoken: Cover 1/3 cup of dried bulgur with 1 cup of boiling water. Cover the bulgur with the boiling water and let it stand about 30 minutes, until soft.

steps.instruction: Pour off any extra water from the bulgur.
Rinse and trim 2 cups of Brussels sprouts.
Cut the Brussels sprouts in half lengthwise.
Slice the halves crosswise into thin strips.
Combine the bulgur, sprouts, 1/2 cup of dried cranberries and 1/4 cup of chopped nuts.
Mix 1/4 cup of orange juice, 2 tablespoons of oil and 2 tablespoons of vinegar.
Add 1/4 teaspoon each of salt and black pepper, and shake or mix well.
Pour the dressing over the salad.

source.name: based.cooking
source.credit: based.cooking contributor Peter Piontek, Ladislao Blanchi

ingredients.name: guanciale or pancetta, cleaned and cubed

steps.instruction: Separate 5 eggs and put only the yolks in a bowl.
Add 1/3 cup of grated Pecorino Romano or Parmigiano-Reggiano to the yolks.
Add a dash of black pepper, if you like.
Beat the yolks and cheese with a fork until smooth and liquid.
Bring a pot of lightly salted water to a boil.
steps.spoken: Bring a pot of water to a boil. Use less salt than you would for usual pasta water.

steps.instruction: Cook 11 ounces of spaghetti for one minute less than the package says.
steps.spoken: Cook 11 ounces of spaghetti for one minute less than the package says.

steps.instruction: Cut 5 ounces of guanciale or pancetta into cubes.
Fry the cubes on low to medium heat until the sides are crisp.
steps.spoken: Fry the guanciale or pancetta in an iron or nonstick pan on low to medium heat, until the sides are crisp but the insides are still chewy. If you use a different kind of pan, add a dash of extra virgin olive oil first.

steps.instruction: Drain the pasta and add it to the bowl with the eggs.
steps.spoken: Drain the pasta and add it to the eggs. If the pasta is too hot it will cook the eggs. If you don't like that, wait for one minute first.

steps.instruction: Stir quickly until the eggs coat the pasta.
Add the guanciale and as much of the pan fat as you like, and keep stirring.
steps.spoken: Add the guanciale or pancetta and as much of the fat left in the pan as you like. Keep stirring.

steps.instruction: Sprinkle with more cheese and black pepper, if you like.

ingredients.name: unsweetened evaporated milk or coconut milk

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 350 °F.
Add 3 pounds of peeled, grated raw cassava to a large bowl.
Add 1/2 teaspoon each of ground cinnamon, black pepper and ground nutmeg.
Add 2 teaspoons of vanilla extract and 4 tablespoons of melted butter or coconut oil.
Add 3/4 cup of brown sugar and 3 cups of evaporated milk or coconut milk.
steps.spoken: Add 3/4 cup of brown sugar and 3 cups of unsweetened evaporated milk or coconut milk.

steps.instruction: Mix everything together well.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish.
Bake for 60 minutes, until firm and golden.
Beat 2 eggs in a bowl.
Mix salt and pepper into the eggs.
Place a cheese slice on each of 2 bread slices.
Sprinkle pepper over the cheese.
Top each one with another bread slice.
Cut each sandwich in half diagonally.
Melt butter in a pan over medium heat.
Dip the sandwich halves in the beaten egg and place them in the pan.
Pan fry the sandwiches, flipping partway, until golden brown on both sides.
Serve right away.

source.name: based.cooking
source.credit: based.cooking contributor carl-zimmerman

steps.instruction: Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a pan.
Add 1 can of drained chickpeas.
Add 1 teaspoon each of garlic powder, cumin, paprika and cayenne pepper.
Cook over medium-high heat for 10 minutes.
steps.spoken: Cook over medium-high heat for 10 to fifteen minutes.

steps.instruction: Add salt and pepper to taste.
Put 8 slices of bread in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
Beat 7 to 8 eggs in a large bowl.
Mix in 1 stick of melted butter and 2 cups of milk.
Mix in 1/2 teaspoon of salt and 1 tablespoon of prepared mustard.
Mix in 1 dash each of red pepper, paprika and garlic powder.
Pour the mixture over the bread.
Sprinkle 2 cups of diced ham over the top.
Top with 2 cups of grated processed cheese.
Refrigerate overnight.
Heat the oven to 350 °F.
Bake for 1 hour.

source.name: based.cooking
source.credit: based.cooking contributor Enzo Stever

ingredients.name: cayenne pepper or hot sauce, optional
butter, for spreading on the muffins, optional

steps.instruction: Blend 3 egg yolks and 1 tablespoon of lemon juice in a blender.
steps.spoken: Blend 3 egg yolks and 1 tablespoon of lemon juice in a blender. This is the base of the hollandaise sauce. You can also whisk them in a double boiler on a gentle simmer instead, which helps keep the sauce from curdling.

steps.instruction: Slowly pour in 1/2 cup of melted butter while blending.
steps.spoken: Slowly pour in 1/2 cup of melted butter while blending. The sauce should thicken and become creamy. If it gets too thick, add a little warm water or lemon juice.

steps.instruction: Season the sauce with cayenne pepper or hot sauce, to taste.
Bring 4 inches of water in a large saucepan to a gentle simmer.
Add 1 tablespoon of white vinegar to the water.
steps.spoken: Add 1 tablespoon of white vinegar to the water. It helps the egg whites set.

steps.instruction: Slide 4 eggs gently into the simmering water.
steps.spoken: Gently slide the eggs into the water. It helps to crack each egg into a small bowl or ladle first, bring it to the surface of the water, and let the egg slide in. Stir the water into a little whirlpool while the eggs cook. Cook for 3 to four minutes.

steps.instruction: Lift the eggs out with a slotted spoon onto a paper towel-lined plate to drain.
Split 2 english muffins and toast them.
Butter both halves of the muffins if you like.
steps.spoken: Butter both halves if you like. You can use any kind of spongy bread instead of the muffins.

steps.instruction: Cook 4 slices of Canadian bacon in a skillet over medium heat until slightly browned.
Put a slice of bacon on each muffin half and top with an egg and hollandaise sauce.
Garnish with chopped chives and more cayenne pepper if you like.
Add 2 cups of shredded injera to a large bowl.
Add 2 cups of cooked chicken, shredded or diced.
Add 1 medium onion, finely chopped, and 2 diced tomatoes.
Add 2 finely chopped green chile peppers.
In a small bowl, whisk 1/4 cup of fresh lemon juice and 1/4 cup of olive oil.
Add 2 cloves of minced garlic and 1 teaspoon of paprika.
Whisk in 1/2 teaspoon of cayenne pepper and salt to taste.
Pour the dressing over the salad in the large bowl.
Toss gently until everything is coated with the dressing.
Let the salad sit for 10 minutes before tasting it.
steps.spoken: Let the salad sit for 10 to 15 minutes, so the flavors blend together.

steps.instruction: Taste the salad and add more salt or spices if you like.
Garnish with fresh cilantro or parsley, chopped.
In a jug, combine 3/4 cup of warm water, 1 teaspoon of sugar and 1 teaspoon of salt.
Add 1 1/2 teaspoons of active dry yeast and mix well.
steps.spoken: Add 1 1/2 teaspoons of active dry yeast and mix well, so the yeast is spread evenly.

steps.instruction: Let the yeast mixture rest for 3 minutes.
steps.spoken: Let the mixture rest for 3 to 4 minutes, to wake up the yeast.

steps.instruction: Pour 2 3/4 cups of flour into a large bowl.
Stir the yeast mixture into the flour.
Knead until the dough is smooth and does not stick to your hands.
steps.spoken: Mix, then knead well until the dough is smooth and does not stick to your hands. If it is still too sticky after a few minutes of kneading, knead in a little more flour.

steps.instruction: Add 1 tablespoon of olive oil and knead again until smooth.
Cover the dough with a damp cloth and let it rest for 20 minutes.
steps.spoken: Cover the dough with a damp cloth and let it rest for around 20 minutes.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 356 °F.
Knead the dough briefly again.
Roll the dough out thin with a rolling pin.
Move the dough to a baking sheet.
Spread 5 heaping tablespoons of tomato sauce over the dough.
Top with 6 slices of prosciutto cotto, close together.
Scatter 1 diced buffalo mozzarella ball over the ham.
Scatter 1/3 cup of grated Emmental over the ham.
Bake at 356 °F for 15 minutes.

ingredients.name: chicken pieces, preferably thighs or drumsticks
fresh parsley or cilantro, chopped, for garnish

steps.instruction: Mix 4 sliced onions, 4 cloves of minced garlic and 2 teaspoons of grated ginger.
Add the juice of 2 to 3 lemons and 3 to 4 tablespoons of olive oil.
Add 1 teaspoon each of Dijon mustard and black pepper, and a pinch of salt.
Mix well to make a marinade.
Add 2 pounds of chicken pieces to the marinade and coat them evenly.
steps.spoken: Add 2 pounds of chicken pieces to the marinade and coat them evenly. Wash your hands after handling raw chicken.

steps.instruction: Cover the bowl and chill it for at least 2 hours.
steps.spoken: Cover the bowl and chill it in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours, but overnight is better.

steps.instruction: Heat 2 tablespoons of vegetable oil in a large pan over medium-high heat.
Take the chicken out of the marinade and keep the marinade.
Place the chicken in the hot pan.
steps.spoken: Place the chicken in the hot pan and cook about 5 to 7 minutes, until the first side is browned.

steps.instruction: Flip the chicken and brown the other side for 5 minutes.
steps.spoken: Flip the chicken and brown the other side for 5 to 7 minutes. Turn it to brown all sides.

steps.instruction: Lower the heat to medium and add the saved marinade to the pan.
Cover the pan and simmer for 20 minutes.
steps.spoken: Cover the pan and simmer for 20 to 25 minutes, until the chicken is no longer pink in the middle and tender. Turn the chicken and stir the onions now and then, so nothing burns.

steps.instruction: Move the chicken to a serving dish.
Sprinkle chopped parsley or cilantro over the chicken.

ingredients.name: fresh parsley or cilantro, chopped, for garnish

steps.instruction: Mix 4 cloves of minced garlic, 1/4 cup of olive oil and 2 tablespoons of lemon juice.
Add 2 teaspoons each of cumin and paprika, and 1 teaspoon of coriander.
Add 1/2 teaspoon of cayenne pepper, 1/2 teaspoon of salt and 1/4 teaspoon of black pepper.
steps.spoken: Add 1/2 teaspoon of cayenne pepper, 1/2 teaspoon of salt and 1/4 teaspoon of black pepper. You can adjust the cayenne to how spicy you like it.

steps.instruction: Mix well until the marinade is smooth.
Place the chicken pieces in the marinade and rub each piece well.
steps.spoken: Place the chicken pieces in the marinade and rub them well, so every piece is coated. Wash your hands after handling raw chicken.

steps.instruction: Let the chicken marinate for at least 2 hours.
steps.spoken: Let the chicken marinate for at least 2 to four hours, so the flavors soak in.

steps.instruction: Heat the grill or a grill pan to medium-high.
Place the chicken on the grill, skin side down, for 10 minutes.
steps.spoken: Place the chicken pieces on the grill, skin side down, and cook for 10 to 15 minutes.

steps.instruction: Flip the pieces and grill 10 more minutes, until no longer pink inside.
steps.spoken: Flip the pieces and grill for another 10 to 15 minutes, until the chicken is no longer pink in the middle and nicely charred.

steps.instruction: Brush any leftover marinade onto the chicken while it grills.
Take the chicken off the grill and let it rest a few minutes.
Sprinkle chopped parsley or cilantro over the chicken.
Serve with lemon wedges.

ingredients.name: heavy whipping cream, whipped to soft peaks

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 350 °F.
Melt 1/4 cup of butter in a large pan over medium heat.
Whisk in 1/4 cup of flour and cook until it is a light blond color.
Add 1 cup of mascarpone, 3 tablespoons of sugar and a pinch of salt.
Add 2 cups of heavy cream.
Bring it to a boil and cook until it is reduced by half.
Take it off the heat and gently fold in the whipped cream.
Put 1 pound of cooked macaroni pasta in a 9 by 13 inch baking pan.
Pour the cheese mixture over the macaroni.
Bake at 350 °F for 25 minutes.
steps.spoken: Bake at 350 °F for 25 minutes, until bubbly on top and puffed up.

ingredients.name: smoked fish, such as catfish or mackerel
red or green bell peppers, diced
Scotch bonnet chile peppers, finely chopped (or to taste)

steps.instruction: Remove any bones from 1 pound of smoked fish.
Flake the fish into small pieces and set it aside.
Heat 2 tablespoons of palm oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add 2 chopped onions and 3 cloves of minced garlic.
Cook until soft and clear.
Add 2 diced tomatoes, 2 diced bell peppers and 2 chopped Scotch bonnet peppers.
Stir well and cook a few minutes, until the vegetables begin to soften.
Add 1 cup of ground dried okra, stirring constantly so it does not lump.
Stir in 1 tablespoon of tomato paste.
Stir in 1 teaspoon each of ground ginger and ground coriander.
Stir in 1 teaspoon of ground cayenne pepper if you want it spicier.
Lower the heat, cover the pot and simmer for 15 minutes.
steps.spoken: Lower the heat to low, cover the pot and simmer for 15 to 20 minutes, until the okra is soft and the flavors have blended.

steps.instruction: Add the flaked fish and gently stir it in. Try not to break it up.
Taste and season with salt and pepper.

source.name: Wikibooks Cookbook
source.credit: Wikibooks contributors, CC BY-SA 4.0

steps.instruction: Sprinkle 1 teaspoon of yeast over 2/3 cup of warm water in a large bowl.
steps.spoken: Sprinkle 1 teaspoon of yeast over the surface of 2/3 cup of warm water in a large bowl. Let it stand for 1 minute.

steps.instruction: Stir the yeast and water until the yeast dissolves.
Mix in 2 cups of flour, 1 teaspoon of salt and 2 tablespoons of olive oil.
Turn the dough out onto a floured surface once it is too thick to stir.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes.
steps.spoken: Knead the dough for 5 minutes. Knead in a little more flour if the dough is too sticky.

steps.instruction: Put the dough in an oiled bowl and cover it.
Set the bowl in a warm place until the dough has doubled in size.
Preheat the oven to 550 °F, or as hot as your oven will go.
steps.spoken: Preheat the oven to 550 °F, or as hot as your oven will go. If you use a pizza stone, preheat it in the oven too, on the lowest shelf.

steps.instruction: Flatten the risen dough on a lightly floured surface.
Roll or stretch the dough into a 12-inch circle on a baking sheet.
steps.spoken: Roll or stretch the dough into a 12-inch circle and put it on a baking sheet. If you use a pizza stone, you can put the pizza on a piece of parchment paper while the stone heats.

steps.instruction: Spread 1 can of tomato sauce evenly over the dough.
Sprinkle on 1 tablespoon oregano, 1 pound mozzarella and 1/4 cup basil.
Sprinkle on 1/2 cup of Romano cheese and 1 teaspoon of red pepper flakes.
Bake the pizza for 12 minutes, until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
steps.spoken: Bake for 12 to fifteen minutes, until the cheese is melted and bubbly and the bottom of the crust is browned when you lift the edge a little.

steps.instruction: Let the pizza cool for 5 minutes before slicing.
Dissolve 1 tablespoon of instant yeast in 1 cup of warm water in a bowl.
Add 1 teaspoon of salt and 2 tablespoons of vegetable oil.
Add 2 cups of durum wheat flour and mix.
Knead it into a dough.
Let the dough rise until it is twice its size.
Divide the dough into 8 pieces and shape them into balls.
Roll each ball into a flat, round bread, 6 inches across.
Heat the oven to 435 °F.
Cover the breads with a cloth and let them rise for 30 minutes.
steps.spoken: Cover the breads with a cloth and let them rise in a warm place for about 30 minutes.

steps.instruction: Bake at 435 °F for 12 minutes.
steps.spoken: Bake at 435 °F for about 12 minutes. This makes 8 pitas.

source.name: based.cooking
source.credit: based.cooking contributor cactar

steps.instruction: Chop the white and light-green parts of 2 large leeks into moderate pieces.
Throw away the dark-green ends of the leeks.
Melt 3 tablespoons of butter in a pot over medium-low heat.
Add the chopped leeks and 11 ounces of sliced potatoes to the pot.
Stir until the leeks are soft.
steps.spoken: Stir until the leeks have sweated down and are soft.

steps.instruction: Add 1 quart of stock, 1 bay leaf and white pepper.
Add 1/2 teaspoon of nutmeg and 1/2 tablespoon of dill weed, if you like.
Raise the heat to medium-high and simmer until the potatoes are tender.
Take the pot off the heat and remove the bay leaf.
Blend the soup with an immersion blender until it is as smooth as you like.
Stir in 3/4 cup of heavy cream and salt to taste.

source.name: USDA MyPlate Kitchen
source.credit: Meeting Your MyPlate Goals on a Budget, MyPlate National Strategic Partners Toolkit

ingredients.name: boneless chicken breast, cut into 1-inch cubes
white onion, cut into small wedges
red bell pepper, cut into 1-inch pieces

steps.instruction: Mix 3 tablespoons soy sauce, 1/4 cup water, 1 tablespoon each honey and cornstarch.
steps.spoken: Mix 3 tablespoons soy sauce, 1/4 cup water, 1 tablespoon each honey and cornstarch. Mix the soy sauce, water, honey and cornstarch in a small bowl and set it aside.

steps.instruction: Heat 1 1/2 tablespoons of oil in a wok or large skillet.
Add 2 cloves of minced garlic.
steps.spoken: Add 2 cloves of minced garlic. Add the garlic and sauté about 1 minute, until the garlic is golden.

steps.instruction: Add 16 ounces of chicken breast cubes.
steps.spoken: Add 16 ounces of chicken breast cubes. Add the chicken and cook about 5 to six minutes.

steps.instruction: Push the chicken to the side of the pan.
Add 1 small onion, in wedges, to the center and cook until slightly tender.
steps.spoken: Add 1 small onion, in wedges, to the center and cook until slightly tender. Add the onion to the center of the pan and cook until slightly tender, then push it to the side.

steps.instruction: Add 3 sliced medium carrots to the center and cook until slightly tender.
steps.spoken: Add 3 sliced medium carrots to the center and cook until slightly tender. Add the carrots to the center of the pan and cook until slightly tender, then push them to the side.

steps.instruction: Add 1 1/2 cups of broccoli florets to the center and cook until slightly tender.
steps.spoken: Add 1 1/2 cups of broccoli florets to the center and cook until slightly tender. Add the broccoli to the center of the pan and cook until slightly tender, then push it to the side.

steps.instruction: Add 1 red bell pepper in 1-inch pieces to the center and cook until slightly tender.
steps.spoken: Add 1 red bell pepper in 1-inch pieces to the center and cook until slightly tender. Add the bell pepper to the center of the pan and cook until slightly tender, then push it to the side.

steps.instruction: Pour the soy sauce mixture into the center and stir until it thickens.
steps.spoken: Pour the soy sauce mixture into the center of the pan, leaving the other food at the sides, and stir until it thickens.

steps.instruction: Mix the sauce in with the vegetables and chicken.
Serve right away over 3 cups of hot cooked brown rice.

ingredients.name: whole or diced tomatoes, 28 ounces each

steps.instruction: Peel and mince 12 cloves of garlic.
Heat 1/2 cup of olive oil in a large pot over low to medium heat.
Add the garlic and heat until golden and fragrant.
Add 1 can (6 ounces) of tomato paste and 4 cans (28 ounces each) of tomatoes.
Add red pepper flakes now, if you like.
Bring to a simmer.
Cook uncovered for 45 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add a pinch of salt, the remaining 1/4 cup of olive oil and basil, if using.
Season 5 salmon steaks with 2 tablespoons of black pepper.
Mix 1 tablespoon of canola oil, 2 tablespoons of soy sauce and 1/4 cup of water.
Stir in 1 tablespoon of honey, 2 tablespoons each of minced ginger and garlic.
Put the salmon on a hot grill and cook for 3 minutes.
steps.spoken: Put the salmon on a hot grill and cook for 3 to 4 minutes.

steps.instruction: Flip the salmon and cook for 3 minutes, until it flakes.
steps.spoken: Flip the salmon and cook for 3 to 4 minutes, until it flakes easily.

steps.instruction: Brush the sauce mixture over the salmon for 2 minutes.
steps.spoken: Brush the teriyaki mixture over the salmon for the last 2 minutes of cooking.

ingredients.name: cream of mushroom soup, 10 ounce can
tuna, 6 ounce can chunk in water
frozen vegetables, such as peas and carrots

steps.instruction: Cook 2 cups of elbow macaroni by the package directions, without salt.
Drain the macaroni and return it to the pot.
Stir in 1 can of cream of mushroom soup.
Drain 1 can of tuna and add it to the pot.
Add 2 cups of frozen vegetables and mix well.
Heat on low for 5 minutes, stirring often.
steps.spoken: Heat on low for 5 minutes, stirring often, if you like crunchy vegetables. Heat longer for softer vegetables.

steps.instruction: Top with 1 cup of crushed potato chips.

steps.instruction: Mix 1 cup of wheat flour with 1/2 tablespoon of ground turmeric.
Add 1/2 teaspoon of kosher salt and 1/4 teaspoon of baking powder.
Stir in 1/3 cup of water and 2 tablespoons of olive oil.
Knead the dough until smooth, about 1 minute.
steps.spoken: Knead the dough for 1 to two minutes, until it is smooth.

steps.instruction: Cover the dough and set it aside for 15 minutes.
Cut the dough into 4 pieces.
Flatten each piece into a 6-inch round.
Heat an oiled skillet over medium-high heat.
Lay 1 round in the hot skillet.
steps.spoken: Lay 1 round in the hot skillet. Cook about 2 minutes, until it is browned, then flip it. Cook the rest one at a time.

steps.instruction: Flip the flatbread when it is browned.

ingredients.name: carrots, cut into long, thin strips
cucumber, seeded and cut into long, thin strips

steps.instruction: Toss 1 cup of carrot strips and 2 cups of bean sprouts in a large bowl.
Add 2 cups of cucumber strips and 1 cup of minced scallions.
Add 1/2 cup of chopped cilantro and 1/4 cup of chopped mint, then toss.
Soak 1 rice paper wrapper in warm water for 1 minute.
steps.spoken: Soak 1 rice paper wrapper in warm water for 1 to two minutes, until it is soft.

steps.instruction: Shake off the extra water.
Place some of the vegetable filling off-center on the rice paper.
Fold it like an egg roll, tucking in the sides to keep the filling inside.
Repeat with the rest of the filling and wrappers.
Serve right away, once all the spring rolls are made.
